summary.description: Summary of 3-8 sentences of how the code manifests in this document. If the code does not appear: 'The code does not manifest in this document.'

variations_observed.description: Internal variations observed: degrees, nuances, contextual differences. Empty array if the code is uniform in this document.

key_evidence.description: Textual evidence supporting the summary. Empty array if no evidence.

segment_index.description: Index of the segment in the provided list (0-based). Optional.

exact_quote.description: Exact verbatim quote from the segment. Do not paraphrase.

claim.description: What the analysis claims this quote evidences.

is_anomaly.description: true if this document is an atypical case for this code (behavior that contradicts or does not fit the general pattern).

anomaly_note.description: If is_anomaly=true, explain why this document is atypical. Empty string if not an anomaly.
